description: This file defines a Java class 'DatabaseSpecificSQLGenerator' responsible for generating SQL queries tailored to specific database dialects (MySQL and PostgreSQL). It provides methods for escaping identifiers, formatting values, constructing SQL clauses (like LIMIT, GROUP_CONCAT), handling date and timestamp functions, and building various SQL statements (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE). It also includes utilities for handling database-specific syntax variations and parameter binding strategies, especially for IN clauses involving large parameter lists.

classes.name: DatabaseSpecificSQLGenerator
classes.description: A component class that generates database-specific SQL statements and fragments, handling differences between MySQL and PostgreSQL dialects, for use in a larger database access layer.

methods.name: getDialect
methods.description: Returns the database type (dialect) currently in use, resolved via DatabaseTypeResolver.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes database identifiers (like table or column names) according to the database dialect (MySQL or PostgreSQL).

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Formats a value based on its JDBC type for inclusion in SQL statements, adding quotes if necessary.

methods.name: groupConcat
methods.description: Generates a dialect-specific SQL expression for concatenating grouped string values.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Generates a LIMIT/OFFSET clause for SQL queries, tailored to the database dialect.

methods.name: calcFoundRows
methods.description: Returns dialect-specific syntax to calculate total rows matching a query, primarily for MySQL.

methods.name: countLastExecutedQueryResult
methods.description: Returns an SQL statement to count the results of the last executed query, varying by database.

methods.name: countQueryResult
methods.description: Wraps a SQL query to count the number of rows it returns, removing limit/offset clauses.

methods.name: currentBusinessDate
methods.description: Returns a database-specific SQL expression for the current business date based on system date.

methods.name: currentTenantDate
methods.description: Returns a SQL expression for the current tenant's date.

methods.name: currentTenantDateTime
methods.description: Returns a SQL expression for the current system timestamp.

methods.name: subDate
methods.description: Generates a SQL expression to subtract a time interval from a date, dialect-specific.

methods.name: dateDiff
methods.description: Generates an SQL expression to compute the difference in days between two dates.

methods.name: castChar
methods.description: Casts a string expression to a character type, dialect-specific.

methods.name: castInteger
methods.description: Casts a string expression to an integer type, dialect-specific.

methods.name: currentSchema
methods.description: Returns the current schema expression for the database dialect.

methods.name: castJson
methods.description: Casts an expression to JSON format, dialect-specific.

methods.name: alias
methods.description: Concatenates a property name with an alias or prefix if provided.

methods.name: buildSelect
methods.description: Constructs a SELECT clause from given fields and alias.

methods.name: buildFrom
methods.description: Builds a FROM clause with optional alias.

methods.name: buildJoin
methods.description: Builds JOIN clause with specified table, alias, join type, and join condition.

methods.name: buildOrderBy
methods.description: Generates an ORDER BY clause from sorting orders.

methods.name: buildInsert
methods.description: Creates an INSERT statement with placeholders for fields.

methods.name: buildUpdate
methods.description: Creates an UPDATE statement with placeholders for fields.

methods.name: fetchPK
methods.description: Extracts the primary key value from a generated key holder after insert.

methods.name: incrementDateByOneDay
methods.description: Generates SQL to add one day to a date column, dialect-specific.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates a dialect-specific IN condition for a list of Long IDs.

methods.name: inParametersFor
methods.description: Returns an array of parameter values suitable for the IN clause, handling PostgreSQL array type or expanded list for MySQL.
